reviews.text: Buy This Game! -The President

[i] Dear devs, let the big mommy milkers companion vampire step on me. In all seriousness, this plays like a Hades-lite with VS elements. [url=https://steamcommunity.com/id/BAEuro/recommended/3275010?snr=1_5_9__402]Beware, however, the developers abandoned their prior title ‘Rogue Loops’[/url] - A good game, but it certainly needed more time in the oven before 1.0. [url=https://steamcommunity.com/id/BAEuro/recommended/2067920?snr=1_5_9__402]I also recommend Rogue: Genesia, which is similar, but better[/url].[/i] [h1]📝 Main Pros, Cons, and Suggestions, followed by the Review:[/h1] 🟩 Pros: + The music is fire + Bosses are enjoyable + Ability to disable skills you don't want to appear + Completing a run unlocks endless mode, allowing you to farm materials + The theme is nailed perfectly through brilliant audio and visual design, delivering a highly thematic experience + Plenty of progression systems to explore, such as companions, equipment, and relics, runes, along with a stat tree + 10 companions, 4 equipment slots, 48 relics, 21 of which are passive (skills), 44 runes, and 47 artifacts 🟥 Cons: - AI voice acting - Gear is nothing more than a stat buff - Bat form to gather experience post run isn’t a fun addition - Due to how skill upgrades work, sometimes fusions are not possible - Board game piece style wobble gets old fast and feels like a lazy way to animate movement - A lack of feeling overpowered, and underwhelming fusions hold this game back from being amazing 🏷️ Suggestions: ~ Adjustable zoom level ~ Character customisation ~ Meaningful gear with additional buffs or perks (like an ARPG) [h1] An above average experience held back by a weak fusion system [/h1] Night Swarm blends the arena combat of Hades with the never-ending enemy spawns of VS, delivering what feels like a ‘lite’ experience of each. Runs play similarly - Spawn in, find the magnifying glass to uncover points of interest, and then gather as much gold as you can to buy upgrades. Survive, and you navigate down a map with branching sections filled with bosses, events, and rest stops. https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3617878005 Other than surviving against mobs, there are also quests to complete which reward reputation, which is used to unlock new companions. Companions have passive bonuses along with a special ability which activates once they generate enough mana. You’ve also got blueprints which you craft to unlock equipment, although this is nothing more than a stat increase. There are runes (of which you can equip 4) and a stat tree for meta progression - All of this, and more, is upgraded in your castle. What’s holding Night Swarm back from being amazing, for me, are the artifacts (skills) and how underwhelming fusions feel - Sometimes they’re just not possible, and when obtained, some feel weak. Further, it doesn’t bring much new to the table, nor are the abilities all that exciting (I never felt broken, unlike with other similar titles), but that doesn’t mean it’s a bad game. Night Swarm is above average, and if you enjoy others in the genre, you’ll likely have fun here. Tread with caution, however, as mentioned in the beginning, [url=https://steamcommunity.com/id/BAEuro/recommended/3275010?snr=1_5_9__402] the developers abandoned their prior title ‘Rogue Loops’ which launched in a similar state to this. I like the mix of roguelite and survivor genre. The art and boardgame token style is charming. But the game doesn't feel 'fun'. It needs more tuning to play better. The weapon upgrades and power-ups don't feel impactful. It feels like you need 6-7+ levels in any kind of weapon size, cooldown, damage, ability upgrade, for it to 'feel' like it's getting powerful, hence the growth curve is way too slow. Damage numbers, particularly 'big' numbers like crits don't pop out so all the damage feels like a blur, contributing to the feel that it's just a slow grind. Survivor-like games live and die based on whether they can make you feel you are snowballing exponentially and 'breaking the game' with each level and upgrade. Feeling like you're 'popping off'. Granted I've only spent 3 hours and finished the 1st act boss -- but if the player is already feeling that the game is grindy in the early game after just a few hours then you should perhaps rethink the tuning and the player journey of your game. I hope this improves because again I like the art and the genre mashup. Not refunding and will stick with it to see what the devs do.

这游戏是真的挺无聊的，简单来说就是把本来属于局外成长的内容，拆分成装备、仆从、基地建设等部分，其需求的材料各异，但共同点都是获取数量较少，具体原因出在关卡过长，每一局需要半小时以上的时间，但是关卡内容基本上玩个三四把就能体验完所有的类型，而局内的等级成长也有问题，由于缺乏一定的拾取范围，导致满屏的掉落物根本捡不完，除非关卡内刷出磁铁等道具，一定程度上能够缓解捡不完经验、金币或局外升级材料的焦虑，但即便如此，也让人觉得很恶心，因为几乎每一局都是如此，时间长了就变成了一种流水线打螺丝的体验。且局内需要用到的资源给的也很少，而局内大部分的互动物基本上都使用同一种货币，这就导致了，每一局很难开完所有地图内的互动物，尤其是第一关，因为缺乏开局金币等成长，但进入关卡内，由于技能成长不足，导致资源获取过少，进而导致了无法高效的获取到资源，且即便是获取到所有的金币之后，也无法满足该关卡内所需的金币。还有就是不得不提的那个符文，其需要升级的材料极为苛刻换言之，普通材料容易获取，但普通材料的成功率极低，而需要提升其成功率的道具则是关卡尾王掉落，一级至二级，每一个该道具可以提升50%的成功率，但是当2-3的时候每一个只能提升25%的成功率，但这不是最幽默的，最幽默的是，我刷出了一个5%经验提升的符文，而其一级只能增加1%的经验提升，我不知道这种数值是怎么出现的，我需要花费最少30分钟，才能拿到1%的经验提升，这合理吗？包括装备等也是，装备老实说，就是纯粹的数值提升，无其他效果，虽然我尚未获取到最高稀有度的装备，老实说，我获取不到，因为想要获取装备，首先需要局内用至少100的金币去拿蓝图，然后，蓝图是有稀有度区分的，且随机获取稀有度，这就导致了，当想要获取局外装备成长的时候就不得不去取舍放弃局内的技能成长或获取遗物。但说实话，至少我个人是很烦这种方式获取装备。 最后则是技能，老实说，就没多少技能，每一局起手可选4个主动技能，主动技能和被动技能共用一个池子，两个特定主动技能10级后可以合成一个效果更佳强力的技能，那么问题来了，最少要20级才能合成出来一个，但是，由于池子过于轮乱，刷新次数又不足，至少我个人体验下来，最少也要五十多级才能合成出来一个，而此时关卡进度已经接近尾王，局内很难合成出第二个，但是即便合成出来也就那样，因为技能就那么几个，多玩几把基本上也就体验完了，而缺乏装备或其它增强形态等特效，导致多玩几把就会开始无聊，尽管我目前只打完了五六个关卡，但此时此刻，我现在已经完全对该游戏丧失兴趣。

游戏体系非常丰富，有技能融合，随机事件，召唤魔仆，局外成长等玩法，其中还可以刷各种稀有装备，结算最后给几秒范围拾取很方便，后期养起来后无双割草。

作者是不是原来做手游的？第一个遇到的幸存者最简单难度第2张地图就开始卡图，开局玩的超不爽，技能攻击范围又低CD又长，第二张地图普通难度怪就密密麻麻的的出，升级还出些乱七八糟的被动，局外需要的材料太多，陷入死循环，打不过，没材料升级，没材料升级，打不过。更可笑的是主动技能要6，7级才能让你勾住，结果升级3选一，被动跑来和主动技能抢池子，结果就是升到10几级主动技能还是1，2级，直接等死吧，没法打了，这些还是最简单难度，后面难度不敢想.吧单机做成经典国产手游套路，第一张图让你爽一下，第2关开始卡图，干脆加个首充68进游戏里吧

说白了，我就是冲着介绍页面的吸血鬼妹子去的，结果呢，她是NPC，不是玩家操控的角色！不过呢，在游戏里能召唤女吸血鬼仆从替自己战斗，也算是弥补了一些遗憾。 游戏画质挺好的，玩法的话跟传统类吸血鬼也差不多，不过将一张图的半小时幸存改成了10张图，每张图3分钟的闯关形式，本质没变，但是每次打3分不至于中途打瞌睡，每张图根据玩家选择的路线不同，场景里也有一些不同的任务跟资源可获取。 难度的话，默认简单难度非常低，随便打都能通关，高难度的话可能需要肝一些，因为游戏的局外构筑非常多，所需资源还都不少，想要内容全解锁的话还是挺累的。但如果你只是抱着偶尔玩一局爽一爽的话，那么这款作品还是能够满足基本需求的。

Steam should make a rule that if you haven't played 10-20 hours of a game, you're NOT allowed to leave a review, because it feels like people are rushing to buy a game, run it, just to negatively review it and then refund it (you can refund a game if you've played under 2 hours of it). Positives: +Fun as hell (especially if you've never played any survivor-like games, including Vampire Survivor) +Art style & game concept (though not original) is so good +Price point is good - Props to Mad Mushroom, they always price their games relatively fairly +Economical game - for less than $10, you get so much hours of gaming, I was replaying level 1 like 10 times over to get stronger before I moved on to the next level +Can be addicting +Upgrades feel satisfying +Story is decent Negatives: -Legit criticism of AI use & overuse -Endless level gets insanely tough at "lucky 100%" level even though you might've leveled up significantly. In over 20 runs, I've completed "lucky 75%" like twice, but never "lucky 100%." -I noticed if you dash while leveling up, the game (sometimes) continues in the background as opposed to pausing for you to pick your next power (relic). This has happened to me like 30 times in 20 hours. -I have to hit the select button twice to pull up the large map. I don't believe it's my Xbox controller, given that I got it this year and barely played/used it. That's the only button that I have to use twice. It happens every time I pull up the large map. There are quality of life changes that could be implemented that would make the experience more satisfying like: 1) Having an information page into how much each of the crystal loot are worth, being able to highlight the names of the abilities (relics) and their fused ability name. 2) Being unable to banish/unselect abilities even temporarily without exiting just to be able to select them one by one from the first ability (currently, you have to keep 7 abilities selected or else it will give you an error message about needing 7 abilities selected, and I think like 9 for the artifacts). Number of edits: 4 (This game is that fun and I want the community to grow)

AI garbage with nothing new brought to the genre. Its not even a bullet hell. The quirk that it is tabletop minis feels lazy, like they couldn't be bothered to engineer real models with full motion. Also the game doesn't pause for cut screens, so you can die during them. I had it happen to the very first cut screen loading into the first run. There is no tutorial to show you mechanics/items/systems work, it just assumes you know how these games work.

https://youtu.be/BfHspOgR3Vc [h1]🧛 Night Swarm 🧛 [/h1] I really enjoyed this game (so far), coming from someone who doesn't normally play or even glance in one direction to bullet-hell style games— this was so much fun to play. While I haven't played a lot yet, I definitely plan on playing a lot more, especially for those nights that I just want to chill and kill some sh*t! Some pros and cons that I've written while playing: [h3]🦇 Pros 🦇[/h3] ⦁ I [b]NEVER[/b] like or play bullet hell types of games and I loved this [i](if that doesn't say something, I don't know what will)[/i]. The concept of this game having a story line made me more intrigued and more willing to want to play because I find myself more interested in these style of games if there is a storyline to follow and/or quests to complete. ⦁ I can't say enough kind things about the music/soundtrack of this game. It keeps me so immersed and engaged during the levels and honestly is my favorite thing about the game so far. I loved the classical style music and this had me JAMMIN' for a lot of it and really made the levels feel much more intense! ⦁ I think the game is somewhat difficult as time goes on, but it's nice that it doesn't feel like it throws you to the wolves at all in the beginning portion of the game. It feels like it's very easy to learn and get going without overwhelming you with information. ⦁ It's such a simple yet addicting game. I found myself losing track of time before I realized I was playing for over an hour. [h3]🦇 Cons 🦇[/h3] ⦁ You can't go back to the castle to return items for quests or upgrade Rodric's perks/stats unless you die or complete the entire path until the boss fight. Give me an option to return to the castle whenever! I don't want to feel stuck with having to complete endless levels to return an item and don't want to force myself to just die. ⦁ [b]I recently found out that the narrating/NPC dialogue is AI-generated and I don't totally love that.[/b] Please consider paying voice actors! I understand this is difficult for smaller indie companies, but trust me when I say that [b]most[/b] of your player base will appreciate it more as it will help with immersive-ness in the game. cant really believe this game isnt an early access game but i guess devs just decided to release it anyway like it has the base of every survivor like game but unlike them there is no reason to actually interact with most of its systems The whole "Trials" quest thingy is actually a waste of time i ran out of things to actually use the resources on before i finished the "20 runs" trial The three difficulties are another useless mechanic they let you earn more and drop better gear but thats all and thats only so it makes those difficulties easier the rock fragments and blood orbs are such a minimal required amount to buy everything thats its just silly that they are even a thing, blood orbs even have a cap you can increase with another currency but that caps out at 4.5k, honestly id used all the required before upgrading it even to 1.5k theres like 30 things to unlock each costing 250 so a total of like 7k needed then there is nothing else for it, the fragments are even less you only need a total of like 2k until your done with them too, and like that half the currencies in the game are useless silk threads are so freely gathered in endless you will legit have 1000s more than you can use, also arachne's mass dismantle is currently bugged and it will shuffle the recipes around interupting your dismantling. Purple gems are a short investment into a "Talent tree" which costs a fair amount but its the generic currency really so you'll fill that in no time then it can atleast be used beside blood gems to upgrade crests Overall its missing a true roguelike experience and in 6 missions you can be done, atleast its cheap

全靠美术的游戏，别的都烂完了，甚至怀疑是氪金手游直接转过来的 养成系统所需的数值完全脚填，比如一块符文强化到10级需要血石114块（不会真有人强化概率拉到90%结果不仅失败了连资源都没了吧，不会啊不会吧），而每一次通关只给1块，这样的符文至少要带四块，还分稀有度；强化装备用的丝绸和血石是一个情况；但是建造建筑和解锁技能、魔仆的资源却远远过量，不明白这么设定想干嘛 整个游戏小怪数值膨胀的极为厉害，第二个难度小怪血量增加21倍，三难度小怪血量增加39倍，而局外养成就给你扣扣嗖嗖增加伤害25%，我这增伤300%全靠装备和符文叠出来的，才勉强在三难度下不刮痧，消耗的血石和丝绸根本是天价（不动用小手段这些资源没1000h以上根本出不来）；这还不是更离谱的，不同难度下金矿的硬度都不一样，你要装备不行，技能没选对，连金矿都打不动。 魔仆系统也够抽象，看起来有一堆人物供你选择，可实际上只有减冷却缩减的那位的必要的，暴击伤害的那个算半个，其余人物全都可以禁止出战 各个技能之间完全不平横，像幽灵颅骨这种技能放高难度先选就是纯等死；还有一堆不带又不行的被动技能干扰升级选项；不同稀有度的技能差距也大的要命，白色技能和金色技能差距都不止1倍，这是在让玩家赌脸？ 局外数值给的全是攻击生命，稍微改变一下游戏机制的功能都没有，你来一个开局自带两个技能，或者升级时技能稀有度提高的选项也好啊 无尽模式更是幽默，就敌人那个强度增长速度，撑个5分钟已经很好了，刷了一整局30~40分的游戏，终于成型了，结果连10分钟都不给爽？ 市面上那么多幸存者游戏，随便找一个特别好评把里面的数值、养成情况抄一下都不会那么烂，当然如果是想做氪金手游的那当我没说

Needs a lot more work to become a decent rogue-like. Items and skills seem very unbalanced. There's a weird soft level cap around 150, numbers go up but you can no longer select passives to upgrade. Can't interact with passive totems either after this point. Stats need to show how much damage each weapon does and how it's calculated.

Game is clearly in early access even though its not marked as such. Lots of AI usage throughout which appears to be place holder until they have the time/money to get actual artists/voice overs done. Needs some work on balance, especially the passive skills and artifacts. A large number of them are useless or nearly useless. The few that are useful will typically have very small upgrades towards the end of the run. Active skills can be combined into a new fusion, but again, some skills are significantly stronger than others. All runs end up the same. You can banish all the active skills you don’t want which basically guarantees you get the couple skills you do want. Points of interest are generally all the same, except for the map "special" which is just one or more meta progression points. Maps are small enough you can do everything then grab the magnet (100% spawn rate) towards the end of the round to always get 100% of the XP/resources. The game is also incredibly easy, to the point I have started falling asleep in the middle of runs. It wasn’t until i did a "Hell" run where i actually had a chance of dying. Bosses are giant damage sponges, but attacks are so few and easily dodged that there is no chance of dying, even if you have a terrible build which does almost no damage. I’m not sure why companions are even on the field with you. The fact they can die and then have to respawn is pointless. None of your stats transfer over so during endless mode they just constantly die. Just make them passive/immortal.

升级道具还有失败概率，本来就很肝了，还为肝而肝，关卡重复性基本没什么区别，按着玩家头肝也是第一次见

这才是真正的吸血鬼幸存者！！！！！ 我一直认为所有的类幸存者游戏都该是后来者居上，作为开山始祖的吸血鬼幸存者因为年度原因有各式各样的问题，后来者如果没有办法解决就算是个失败的游戏，可惜这么多年过去了绝大多数游戏别说优化缺点了甚至连原本该有的优点都没继承（点名批评球比伦）然而在这游戏上，我居然看到了所有我想象该有的类幸存者游戏该有的样子！ 首先最大的优点就是难度梯度设置合理，除了第一把连地图上的各个光点代表什么还没分清草草撞死后，普通难度每一关我就一次没死一口气把boss打通，虽然前期局外成长没起来之前去硬挑战更高难度纯纯被秒，但是这游戏关卡还挺多，至少把所有地图解锁之前理论上说遇不到高难度的怪，这点对比吸血鬼幸存者确实是大幅优化，至少不会让初始的白板角色在一点数值都没加的第一张图死个N次才能在局外成长的帮助下打通。第二点就是局外成长相当丰富，有的类幸存者游戏只学了个皮毛，觉得局外只需要无脑给你数值让你原本打不过的怪进去能秒就行，殊不知这样的游戏体验不到这类游戏真正的爽点，这类游戏最爽的时刻无非是普通武器合成只会从被怪追着打瞬间变成秒天秒地的快感，所以怎么让武器快速成型是重点！反映到这游戏里和其他游戏最大的区别，就是大部分这类游戏都是只能ban几种武器，而这游戏的至少选择7种武器约等于每把进游戏之前就能保证我在冲着我想要合成的毕业武器去（装备栏总共能带4把武器，7种刚好2+2+2+1）而且这游戏武器最人性化的一点就是刚解锁你就能知道哪两个武器可以合成，而不用照着网上的攻略或者像排列组合一样自己慢慢试，这点值得所有类幸存者游戏学习！！！！！除此之外还有各种用于成长的货币，虽然看着复杂其实无脑用就行后面都很好刷，而且用的每一笔货币都有客观成长不怕浪费。说完游戏外再说游戏内，相较于吸血鬼幸存者每张地图只有最开始做成就或者解锁人物需要走动，一把到了15分钟后基本都开始原地挂机，但是这游戏每张大地图被拆成了9个小关卡，每个关卡里又有几个任务，中间包含了开地图，杀怪，占点，救人等小任务分布在一关的各个角落，每关3分钟让人每一秒都有事干（就是前期时间实在有点少，移速慢了经常任务没跑完时间到了要去下一关）至于游戏内容本质上就是吸血鬼幸存者的换皮，这次主角真是吸血鬼......不过有个让我眼前一亮的点就是这游戏的音乐，我还是第一次听到小提琴和贝斯能这么丝滑的无缝切换，有一种既有吸血鬼的优雅又有boss战紧张刺激的感觉。 至于缺点其实也是有的，目前这游戏最大的缺点就是内容，武器种类确实没办法和吸血鬼幸存者比，不过一个发售俩月的游戏和一个卖了N年DLC的游戏比内容量确实有点扯了，这点我能期待制作人慢慢更新，另一个就是无限模式之前成长的幅度太低，我不知道经验全部升满后是什么样，但是我现在的体验就是如果要凑2+2+2+1的武器，最多只能刚把3把武器合成出来，这还是小概率事件，更多的情况是只能合2把武器，更别说把所有武器升满了，就在这种情况下让我去打无限模式，确实坚持不了几分钟，我是觉得可以把地图上花金币开箱子的点分成两类，一类花小金币只给一个箱子，一类是花大金币开三个箱子，比一百多金只能给一个属性稍微好一点的传送武器好很多，还是我前面那个逻辑，这类游戏前期一定要成型快，堆属性那是成型后该考虑的事！关于这点我其实从之外玩过的某个类幸存者小黄油那学到点经验，就是武器合成之前和现在不变，但是合成之后直接把等级上限取消，把武器描述从X/10变成+X，然后成长的属性不固定死，可以从伤害爆率爆伤范围攻速等等随机出词条，传说4词条史诗3词条以此类推，现在这游戏在我看来主要就是深度不够，那个小黄油武器种类比这游戏还少但是每局的深度都更大，虽然这游戏的深度着重在局外的刷装备上，但是有个不可避免的事就是一个刚入坑的新玩家不论怎么尝试都不可能在局外成长没有秒天秒地之前体验太深的内容，即使他把把天胡，但如果能做到我说的这两点（前期多几个X3的箱子，以及合成武器取消等级上限让玩家自定义属性成长方向）即使新玩家刚上手还没太多的局外成长也可以靠运气在这一局里爽翻天，毕竟现在的情况是，运气特别好的玩家在这一局里掉了毕业武器既不能升级也不能装备，等于这运气带来的爽感有滞后性（然后下把带着毕业武器开局连roll三次没出想要的武器心态炸了）

Night Swarm is a vampire-themed roguelite “survivor-like” where you play as a vampire lord fighting endless waves of enemies while building powerful combinations of skills, relics, and companions. The game has mostly positive reviews on Steam (around 79% positive from hundreds of players), so overall reception is quite good. The game clearly takes inspiration from titles like Vampire Survivors, but adds more RPG elements such as castle upgrades, companions, and talent trees that give each run a bit more depth. 👍 Pros Fun and addictive “survivors-like” gameplay Many abilities, relics, and companions that allow different builds Good meta-progression with castle upgrades and talents Stylish visuals and satisfying combat feedback Runs well even on handheld devices like Steam Deck Great value for the price if you enjoy the genre 👎 Cons Gameplay can become repetitive after many runs Heavy RNG sometimes forces builds you don’t really want Some systems and resources feel a bit overwhelming at first Boss fights are not very memorable Some players reported balance issues or bugs early after release Final Thoughts Night Swarm doesn’t reinvent the survivor-like genre, but it adds enough ideas to make it enjoyable for fans. If you like games where you experiment with builds and fight huge enemy swarms, this is an easy recommendation. Just be ready for some repetition after longer sessions.

会买这款游戏纯粹是为了做一下研究。 老实说，玩久了有点腻。 核心 Loop 就是找水晶，找装备，然后找吸铁的节奏。只要速度和攻击力跟得上，用什么技能都不会改变这种玩法。基本上就是普通模式走一遍就已经可以想到后面的玩法了，剩下的就是赌人品来面对数据上调的关卡而已。 由于大量重复，我已经把 voice 给关掉。一直叫我去死的旁白非常中二。虽然他的功能就是制造不必要的干扰，这种 voicing 只会让玩家直接迁怒，少点声音，少点噪音，少点恨意。 至于颜色方面，我明白吸血鬼的主色是红，所以选了相对明显的紫蓝色。但开发团队有没有想过，这种颜色和冰主题的地板配起来，居然能让红绿色盲的人感受到蓝色盲的困境。你们确定不要使用动态补色？ 有些技能到后面根本就是视觉杀手。杀死你的不止有数据怪，还有各种颜色叠加闪屏技能。 最后就是，我是不知道怎么搞的，手柄体验非常差，尤其是技能选择上面，经常可以被遥感抖动给错误选择。搞得我每次选技能还得是用键盘选，用手柄偶尔还会出现往左卡死的情况，同一个手柄玩其他游戏都没有这么敏感，却完全不提供 Deadzone 和防抖的实装机制，有点不太可以。 如果你的预算有限，去玩更好玩的东西吧。
玩了十个小时都是硬撑下来的，太枯燥太无聊了，游戏中我只需要去探图捡金子然后选选图腾最后几秒赶到吸铁石旁边吸金子吸经验就行了，打关底boss的时候手里只有一个融合过后的法术，后期变强以后击杀小怪也没有体验到割草的感觉，解锁技能又很肝，局内游戏时间还很少，几乎是一刻不停的在跑来跑去，画面颜色也看着难受，一点也不好玩

The gameplay is generally pretty fun, with decent mechanics and growth potential. However, this game was clearly designed to resemble a board game, with bases on each character/monster and bouncing around like you're moving a piece on a game board. That is one of the stupidest decisions I've ever seen in any video game. Any developer involved with approving that decision to go forward with that should no longer be in game development, and should find something to do more suited to their capabilities. Like watching paint dry. While someone supervises them to be sure they're not doing something stupid. Seriously, it's absolute garbage. That one decision alone brings an otherwise easy thumbs-up down to a coin toss decision of up vs down. They lost the coin toss. It really is stupid looking and you never get away from it.

Pros: - Original concept of Vampire Survivors-like game (fast paced battles, rogur-lite map, base building, etc.). - Pretty good graphics (table game concept is a pro for me, too). - Many weapons and their evolutions, many artifacts and temporary buffs. - We can manage what weapons and skills we can encaounter. - 4 biomes, 3 levels each, 3 difficulty levels each. Cons: - The last 3 bosses of the 4th biome seem unfinished? Well, it's actually one and the same boss with two phases. And judging by the trophies, there should be three different bosses here, same as in all previous biomes. - Unbalanced Igor's quests (unworthy rewards, huge goals). - A tiny number of the hub upgrades. - UI and controls bugs. They are minor, and that's the most frustrating these things don'r get a fix. - Bad UI solutions (for example, you can increase Blood Stones amount cap in... a battle talents tree? I bet, you will be disoriented when you will play this game the first couple of times). - Poor resources balance. - Poor weapons balance. There are absolute goats like Terror Wings (Wings of Dusk + Doomwing) and absolute dogfart like Cursed Shuriken (Blood Shuriken + Skull Minefield) which is somehow worse than its two "weapon ingerients" separetly. - Only one playable booby character, only one booby NPC in the hub, and only one BIG BOOBY companion. Everything else is a mere dickwilders. Why? No, why? - Asmongold as a vampire (and we know he is a cockroach-o-mancer). Still, I hope this emo Twilight saga will become one of the best Survivors-like games. It has potential, just fix some minor bugs (UI mostly), finish the bosses and add some more upgrades for we could spend tonnes or the resources we hoard.

First the good: [list] [*]The art direction/style is good, you can't go wrong with propper vampires. [*]Bonus points for voice acting. [*]You can nudge the runs so that you don't constantly get stuff you don't run, you can pre-ban powers, banish mid run if you don't want more speed or something, and you can reroll, the classic roguelite fixing the drop pool. [*]The meta progression is strong, it's actually a little too strong. [/list] The negative: [list] [*]You only need a little Meta progression and you become overpowered. [*]4 Zones, 3 "locations" pr. zone, each zones gimmicks can be boiled down to [b]"Keep Moving"[/b] and/or [b]"Avoid this"[/b]. [*]3 Difficultys but in reality it's just a tedius "play each location 3 times", you can't skip ahead you have to clear normal to unlock "Nightmare", the same for nightmare to unlock "Hell", they supposedly have more health? But I literally ran them over with 0 effort. [*]The only real difference between locations is the boss, which doesn't matter at some point as you'll have more than enough damage to kill them in 2 seconds almost every run. [*]This wouldn't be such a big problem if each locations maps wheren't basically the same circly/boxy blob, once you get to the point of fully exploring each map you get into a loop of fully farming the map and waiting around for the timer to run out, so you can do it again. [*]The figurine aesthetic isn't used at all, if it's just to hide a lack of animations fine, but play a little into it, have a giant hand move them around once in a while (like on the map), have them melt like a plastic figure under a magnifying glass when they die, make some dollhouse props, anything to make the game a little more fun to look at. [*]None of the classic Vampire weaknessses are exploited here at all, no sunlight, crosses, garlic or stakes. [*]Boss cutscenes play [b][u]Every-Damn-Time[/u][/b], the same for a end of run animation where you float out of your coffin, and to skip them you have to hold F. [*]SOOOOooooo many "Hold" prompts on things that shouldn't have them, want to exchange a useless resource for blood? Hold X then Hold F and whatever you do don't touch the mouse or it might set the amount back to [b]Zero[/b], want to level up a companion? Hold F, for each level (18 levels each), same for runes and equipment. (also rerolls and banishes) [/list] I can't recommend it for the price, it just doesn't have enough fun factor, but I'm aiming to 100% as many games as I can so I might be overly negative because I had to play the same loop 36+ times. 4 zones X 3 Locations X 3 diff = 36 runs minimum for the "Clear each location on all difficulties" achievement. Doesn't help I was already bored before I completed the initial 12 runs, theres not enough variety.

[h1]我说类吸血鬼幸存者游戏还得用吸血鬼玩 [/h1] [h2]玩法：[/h2] 幸存者+爬塔+刷宝+哈迪斯的结合玩法，在基地（城堡）有局外成长，进副本后可以类似于杀戮尖塔的爬塔选择路线，在多条岔路中选择一条进入战斗地图或者事件，分叉路的末端是副本boss战。地图战斗类似于哈迪斯，人物和敌人都是仿棋子底座设计，走起来是棋子蹦跳的质感。 在基地城堡可以选择三种人物，最开始是基础的罗德里克，后续可以解锁艾洛温、埃德拉斯。选择人物之后，走到右上角的传送门就可以进入副本。 在副本中选择路线图中的战斗点后，会进入战斗地图，系统会生成一张随机分为若干区域的地图，地图中所包含的重要资源以及精英怪情况会显示在路线图的选择介绍中，击杀精英之后可以获得神器和物品。 路线图中会出现事件，可能触发不同的效果，也会出现篝火，篝火提供的选项都能恢复全部生命，还可以再获得4-8个等级或是获得神器和黄金。 每个副本都可能掉落不同稀有度的物品，可以用来场外加成，打完一个副本之后还可以进入无尽模式，追梦一波掉落物品。 [b]游戏内的资源和稀有度设定—— [/b] 游戏内有黄金、紫色精华、绿色声望、红色血矿石、魔力之丝、伟业等资源，黄金可以在副本地图里商店购买使用，紫色精华可以在基地点天赋，声望可以强化魔仆，血矿石可以开新技能，魔力之丝可以强化物品装备，伟业可以强化基地城堡。 技能和物品的稀有度从低到高分别为：灰色普通、蓝色罕见、紫色稀有、金色传说 [b]技能—— [/b] 游戏内的权能，有主动和被动之分，最多可以获得四个主动技能，技能升到10级之后就可以和另外一个技能融合成为新技能，同时空出一个技能位。（可以融合的技能对象在选择时会显示） [b]地图内—— [/b] 每张地图的战斗时间大概在3分钟左右，进地图后就会有一个倒计时，时间到了就结束。 地图有各种事件点，站到上面一段时间后就可以激活效果，有可以揭示当前区域地图的探查点，也有在上面击杀一定数量敌人之后就可以召唤一个魔仆的召唤血阵。 地图里会随机出现图腾柱商店，花费黄金后可以抽奖获得神器、技能等，不同的图腾柱颜色代表了不同的产出物品，比如绿色图腾柱会出现神器，红色会出现技能。 打碎地图上存在的紫色结晶柱子就可以掉落获得紫色精华，打碎黄色的就可以获得黄金。 每张地图战斗结束后会触发几秒的【收集阶段】，会获得非常高的移速，快速穿梭在地图中收集遗落道具，这一点很不错，可以最后收集点经验，不过一般还是用全图磁力吸引比较好。 [b]放逐设定——[/b] 在副本里选择技能时，或者在基地城堡里都可以使用放逐机制，选择一些技能或者神器，让它在副本里不会出现。（不过需要保证最低携带数量，比如技能是最少带7个） 可以有效地防止一些较弱的技能或神器污染选择池，很不错的一个设定。 [b]局外成长——[/b] 副本里获得的物品可以带出并在城堡的丝线大师处进行装备、强化、分解。 紫色精华可以在基地城堡里进行局外强化，点出符文或者天赋。 绿色声望可以用来解锁新的魔仆，还可以强化他们或者放逐。 红色血矿石可以在城堡魔法书那里解锁新的主动技能、可融合技能、被动技能、神器，还可以在魔法书处放逐 伊戈尔会发布先祖试炼任务，累计完成后就可以获得声望奖励和试炼经验，提升试炼等级后可以获得额外奖励。 [h2]小技巧： [/h2] 魔仆很好用，在副本里看到有魔仆的点位直接选就完事了，魔仆开技能的时候还会给一个把周边小怪全推开的效果，对聚怪地图的控场很好用。 地图内优先把神器点出来，然后技能尽量选可以融合的，这样子后面可以空出技能位来放新技能。 [h2]游玩感想：[/h2] 1、局外成长太多太繁琐，需要收集的资源种类五花八门，对于肝来说不是很友好。 2、图腾商店花黄金抽奖但是没有保底，很多100+黄金的商店出个普通品质东西真的心态崩了。。。。 3、游戏内有一些文本存在错误，比如魔仆【查恩·萨维尔】的技能效果出现赘字情况，“效技能持续期间”应该为“技能持续期间”，然后一些技能的效果描述不够清晰。 4、不是，你这强化怎么还有成功率？？我那一瞬间以为自己在玩页游强化装备赌概率呢。。。就直接给个固定数额不行吗，非要人赌概率强化干啥啊。 5、无尽模式的小怪数值给的是不是太离谱了，除非走闪避流和回血流，不然根本挡不住无尽小怪潮的攻击啊！ [h2]总结： [/h2] 融合了幸存者、哈迪斯、爬塔、刷宝等多种玩法，扮演三位吸血鬼中的一位，进入副本选择分叉路线，出现战斗就会进入一张生成地图进行限时3分钟的战斗，战斗中升级可以三选一升级技能。副本路线尽头是boss，打完后可以选择回城堡或继续打无尽模式。在副本中可获得黄金、紫色精华、声望、血矿石、伟业等多种资源用于局内局外强化，资源种类较多，肝度需求较高，且符文之类的强化有成功率。
